record.excerpt: The strategy is based on the price of BTC-USD on the last day of the month … involves buying when the price is above the 200-day simple moving average (SMA) … and selling when it is below. … The strategy has been profitable so far, but its future profitability is not guaranteed.
record.performance_claim: The strategy has been profitable so far
record.notes: Monthly-rebalanced close vs 200-day SMA filter on BTC; vague profitability claim only.

spec.claim_summary: Hold BTC when its price on the last day of the month is above the 200-day simple moving average and sell when below.
spec.untestable_reason: The strategy requires evaluating signals only on the last day of each month, which the schema cannot express.
assumptions: BTC-USD mapped to Binance spot symbol BTCUSDT.
Timeframe 1d reflects daily bars needed for 200-day SMA, but claim does not state a bar timeframe.
Direction long-only reflects buying to hold and selling to exit, not shorting.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: evaluation on the last day of the month cannot be expressed (schema has no day-of-month filter); testing close vs 200-day SMA on every daily bar would change trade timing and misrepresent the claim.

issues.problem: Claim requires evaluation 'on the last day of the month'; spec evaluates close vs 200-day SMA on every daily bar, omitting the month-end timing filter. Disclosed as NOT EXPRESSIBLE in assumptions but omission changes trades tested.
